summary: Iteration 2 testing: verified responsive nav fix (Header.jsx) + fruit builder redesign (FruitDetail.jsx). Backend regression 21/21 passed. Frontend critical flows all pass: nav links visible/clickable at 768/1024/1280/1366/1440/1920; hamburger only <768; search only >=1280; customize-bucket from md+. Fruit builder: removed testids (bucket-lines/capacity/total/review-btn) absent as intended; 'Orchard-Picked Individual Fruits' chip removed; variant 1 adds +1 to cart, variant 3 adds +3; cart drawer shows correct ₹1,120; quick-buy navigates to /checkout; mobile sticky bar shows live total; mobile review -> /checkout; empty review does NOT navigate; tabs (nutrition/packaging/fruit) render. Hamper detail qty+add works; admin login+dashboard+enquiries+settings save all pass. Guest checkout submission produced UF1004 and cart cleared.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking mobile-bucket-review with empty cart correctly prevents navigation but the expected error toast was not detected via DOM query within 600ms (sonner may auto-dismiss or render via portal). Non-blocking - navigation prevention works.

issues: Minor horizontal overflow detected (document.scrollWidth > clientWidth). Logo + 5 nav pills + Customize Bucket + cart just barely overflow at exactly 768px. Not visually broken but a small amount of horizontal scroll exists. From 1024px upward there is no overflow and layout is clean. User's reported laptop screens (1024-1920) all look clean.

action_items: Optional: tighten nav padding at 768px or raise nav/customize-bucket breakpoint to md+ (currently acceptable; nav visible and clickable, only ~a few px overflow). Not a user-facing bug at the originally reported laptop widths.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: both the search form and Customize Bucket use `ml-auto` while the cart button also uses `ml-auto`. Multiple ml-auto siblings causes layout to compress at 768px; consider explicit flex spacing.
Overall code quality is good: proper data-testids, env-driven URLs, async flows correct, no MongoDB _id leaks observed.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical flows pass; only 768px minor overflow + mobile empty-toast detection minor)

seed_data_creation: Created one test enquiry UF1004 (TEST Reviewer, +919812345678) via guest checkout flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct admin login testids are admin-email-input / admin-password-input (not admin-email). Hamper add-to-cart testid is hamper-add-cart (not hamper-add-bucket). Fruit variant qty parses correctly from v1='1 pc', v3='3 pc'. Backend suite path /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py works out of the box with pytest.
rca of the issue: N/A - verifying fixes, no new bugs found. Original reported nav-not-showing-at-laptop bug is resolved (nav visible at 1024/1280/1366/1440/1920 with no overflow).
